mgPerUnitNote: 2 mg or 4 mg nicotine per piece
dosingNotes: 2 mg for people smoking 20 or fewer cigarettes a day; 4 mg for more than 20 a day and heavy vapers. Chew one piece when you want to smoke, using the chewing technique in the leaflet (about 30 minutes per piece). One piece at a time. Packs of 105 (blister strips of 15) and 210.
notes: Sold under the Nicorette gum licences: emc lists NicAssist names as alternatives on the Nicorette Freshmint and Fruitfusion 2 mg SmPCs. Each flavour comes in both 2 mg and 4 mg. Some newer Boots bundle listings call it 'NicAssist Mint Gum'. dm+d had an NHS indicative price for the Minty Fresh 210 pack dated 24-10-2025.

mgPerUnitNote: 1 mg or 2 mg nicotine per compressed lozenge
dosingNotes: 1 mg for people smoking fewer than 20 cigarettes a day; 2 mg for heavier smokers. Suck one lozenge every 1-2 hours as needed, no more than one per hour. Most people use 8-12 a day. Treat for at least 3 months; use beyond 6 months is generally not recommended. Pack of 96. The 2 mg page says adults 18 and over.
notes: The two strengths have different daily maximums, so store the maximum per strength. There is no NicAssist 4 mg lozenge and no NicAssist mini lozenge.

mgPerUnitNote: Nominal nicotine delivered over 16 hours: 25 mg (Step 1), 15 mg (Step 2), 10 mg (Step 3)
dosingNotes: Apply one patch on waking to clean, dry, hairless skin and remove it 16 hours later (at bedtime). Typical heavy-smoker programme: 25 mg daily for 8 weeks, then 15 mg for 2 weeks, then 10 mg for 2 weeks. If Step 1 causes side effects that don't settle, the 15 mg SmPC allows switching to 15 mg for the rest of the 8 weeks, then 10 mg for 4 weeks. Adults and children aged 12 and over. Packs of 7; a Step 1-3 bundle is also sold.
notes: Same licences as Nicorette Invisi: emc lists NicAssist Translucent as the alternative name on the Invisi 10/15/25 mg SmPCs.

mgPerUnitNote: Average nicotine delivered over 24 hours. Nicotine contained per patch: 21 mg = 52.5 mg, 14 mg = 35 mg, 7 mg = 17.5 mg
dosingNotes: Three-step programme: 21 mg (Step 1), then 14 mg (Step 2), then 7 mg (Step 3), about 3-4 weeks per step. The starting step depends on cigarettes smoked per day. Apply one patch a day and leave it on for 24 hours. Do not cut patches. Contains aluminium: remove before medical scans. Packs of 7.
notes: Appears discontinued: the Boots 14 mg product page now returns an error, and the only other listings are eBay resales. Boots has not confirmed this. The leaflet's wording on which step lighter smokers start at was ambiguous in the extracts I saw, so the exact starting-step thresholds are not recorded.

mgPerUnitNote: 2 mg nicotine per sublingual tablet
dosingNotes: Place under the tongue to dissolve; do not chew or swallow. One microtab an hour for lighter smokers, or two an hour for heavier smokers (more than 20 cigarettes a day). Most people use 8-24 a day. Pack of 100. Licensed for 12 and over; Boots online restricts sales to 16 and over.
notes: Shares one SmPC with Nicorette Microtab 2 mg ('Nicorette Microtab or Boots NicAssist 2 mg microtab').

mgPerUnitNote: 0.5 mg nicotine per spray (50 microlitres of 10 mg/ml). One dose is one spray in each nostril, which is 1 mg.
labelMaxPerDay: 64 sprays (32 doses), at most 2 doses an hour
dosingNotes: One spray in each nostril as needed for cravings, no more than twice an hour, for up to 16 hours a day. The 10 ml bottle gives about 175 sprays. Adults and children aged 12 and over.
notes: Same licence as Nicorette Nasal Spray (emc 6207). dm+d updated its NHS indicative price on 24-10-2025, but the Boots online page showed 'stock coming soon' (temporarily out of stock online). Store strength as 0.5 mg per spray so the app can log single sprays.

mgPerUnitNote: 1 mg nicotine per spray
labelMaxPerDay: 64 sprays (no more than 2 sprays per dose and 4 sprays an hour)
dosingNotes: 1-2 sprays into the mouth when cravings start. Do not exceed 2 sprays per dose, 4 sprays an hour or 64 sprays a day (4 an hour for 16 hours).
notes: Appears discontinued. Trolley.co.uk shows it out of stock at every store, the only listings are eBay resales, and dm+d's 1 mg/dose oromucosal spray suppliers list only Nicorette QuickMist and Nicotinell Rapid Relief. The leaflet is dated 2018 and names Niconovum AB as the marketing authorisation holder. Pack size is unclear: Trolley lists 17.2 ml and eBay lists 200 sprays.

mgPerUnitNote: 15 mg nicotine contained per cartridge. This is the cartridge content, not the amount absorbed.
dosingNotes: Puff on the inhalator when you feel the urge to smoke. Do not use more than 6 cartridges a day. Adults and children over 12. Packs of 4 and 20 cartridges.
notes: dm+d marks the product discontinued, with the 20-cartridge pack discontinued on 01-04-2025. The 4-cartridge pack had no discontinuation date, but Trolley shows the product out of stock everywhere. An older NicAssist 10 mg inhalator (42 cartridges) was discontinued in 2013. Users may still hold stock, so keep this entry for logging.

mgPerUnitNote: 2 mg nicotine (as 13.2 mg nicotine resinate) or 4 mg nicotine per piece
dosingNotes: 2 mg for people smoking fewer than 20 cigarettes a day; 4 mg for more than 20. Sugar-free. Chew one piece when tempted to smoke. Pack of 96.
notes: Peppermint is confirmed on the 4 mg page only. The 13.2 mg resinate figure and the ingredients match Galpharm Nicotine Replace gum, so this is probably the same Wrafton/Perrigo-made product (inferred, not confirmed). Product pages were live with prices, but their dates are unclear.

mgPerUnitNote: 2 mg or 4 mg nicotine per lozenge (as nicotine resinate)
dosingNotes: 2 mg if your first cigarette is more than 30 minutes after waking; 4 mg if it is within 30 minutes. 12-week programme: weeks 1-6, one lozenge every 1-2 hours (at least 9 a day), then reduce. Contains aspartame. Packs of 72 (2 mg also sold as a 216 bundle).
notes: I could not read the daily maximum on the Superdrug page itself. 15 comes from the same-design own-label and Galpharm lozenge labels, which use the same waking-time rule and 12-week programme. The 2 mg 36-pack (p/384828) is no longer available online. Stock signals for the 4 mg pack conflicted.

mgPerUnitNote: 2 mg or 4 mg nicotine per piece
dosingNotes: 2 mg for people smoking fewer than 20 cigarettes a day; 4 mg for more than 20. Sugar-free. Adults and children 12 and over (4 mg page). Pack of 96.
notes: Flavour not confirmed for the current Tesco Health packs. An older Tesco 'Nicotine Replace' 4 mg gum was peppermint. The 4 mg page had a Clubcard price running to 11/04/2026, so it was listed in 2026.

mgPerUnitNote: 2 mg or 4 mg nicotine per lozenge
dosingNotes: 2 mg if your first cigarette is more than 30 minutes after waking; 4 mg if it is within 30 minutes. At least 9 a day in weeks 1-6, then reduce. Sugar-free. Packs of 72 and 144.
notes: Sold as 'Tesco Nicotine ... Lozenges'; Trolley also labels one as 'Tesco Health'.

mgPerUnitNote: 2 mg nicotine (as 13.2 mg nicotine resinate) or 4 mg nicotine per piece
dosingNotes: 4 mg for more than 20 cigarettes a day. Adults and children 12 and over. Chew one piece when strongly tempted to smoke. Pack of 96.
notes: Made by Wrafton Laboratories (Perrigo) for Asda Stores Ltd. The Asda 2 mg page reportedly also says 'more than 20 cigarettes a day', which looks like a copy error: elsewhere 2 mg is for fewer than 20.

mgPerUnitNote: 2 mg or 4 mg nicotine per lozenge
dosingNotes: 2 mg if your first cigarette is more than 30 minutes after waking; 4 mg if it is within 30 minutes. Sugar-free. Packs of 72 (144 also listed).
notes: Made by Wrafton Laboratories for Asda. I could not read the daily maximum on the Asda page itself. 15 comes from identical own-label and Galpharm lozenge labels.

mgPerUnitNote: 2 mg or 4 mg nicotine per piece
dosingNotes: 2 mg for people smoking fewer than 20 cigarettes a day (the 2 mg label says adults 18 and over); 4 mg for more than 20 a day (12 and over). Chew using the leaflet technique for about 30 minutes. Contains maltitol. Pack of 96.
notes: The ingredients (maltitol, sucralose, BHT) match the Galpharm/Wrafton gum. A price-tracking site recorded a price change on 12 May 2026.

mgPerUnitNote: 2 mg or 4 mg nicotine per lozenge (4 mg = 26.66 mg nicotine resinate)
dosingNotes: 4 mg if you smoke within 30 minutes of waking; otherwise 2 mg. Contains aspartame and mannitol. Packs of 72 ('Sainsbury's Nicotine Lozenges, Peppermint') and 144 ('Sainsbury's + Healthcare Nicotine Lozenges').
notes: Sources are price-aggregator pages, not the Sainsbury's product page. The daily maximum was not read directly; 15 comes from the identical Galpharm lozenge, which also uses 26.66 mg resinate.

mgPerUnitNote: 2 mg or 4 mg nicotine per piece
dosingNotes: 2 mg for people smoking fewer than 20 cigarettes a day; 4 mg for more than 20. Sugar-free. Pack of 96.
notes: Made by Wrafton Laboratories for Wm Morrison Supermarkets. Peppermint is confirmed for 2 mg via a review site; I assumed the same for 4 mg because it is the same line. The 2 mg gum is also listed on Amazon UK.

mgPerUnitNote: 2 mg or 4 mg nicotine per lozenge
dosingNotes: 12-week programme: weeks 1-6, one lozenge every 1-2 hours, stepping down to one every 4-8 hours in weeks 10-12. Do not use for more than 9 months. Pack of 72.
notes: Flavour not confirmed (probably peppermint, like the other own-label lozenges). The daily maximum was not read directly on the page; 15 comes from the same-programme own-label and Galpharm lozenges. Trolley showed the 2 mg 72-pack out of stock everywhere at one point.

mgPerUnitNote: 2 mg nicotine (as 13.2 mg nicotine resinate) or 4 mg nicotine per piece
dosingNotes: 2 mg for people smoking fewer than 20 cigarettes a day; 4 mg for more than 20. Chew using the leaflet technique for about 30 minutes. Do not eat or drink with a piece in your mouth. Sugar-free (maltitol, sucralose). Pack of 96.
notes: Galpharm is Perrigo's UK value brand. The supermarket own-label gums (Asda, Morrisons, Sainsbury's, probably Superdrug and Tesco) appear to be the same Wrafton/Perrigo product. Age guidance differs between listings: '12 and over' vs adult-only.

mgPerUnitNote: 2 mg nicotine (as 13.33 mg nicotine resinate) or 4 mg nicotine (as 26.66 mg nicotine resinate) per lozenge
dosingNotes: 2 mg if your first cigarette is more than 30 minutes after waking; 4 mg if it is within 30 minutes. Weeks 1-6: one lozenge every 1-2 hours (at least 9 a day), then step down over 12 weeks. About 15 mg sodium per lozenge. Sugar-free; contains aspartame. Pack of 36.
notes: Wrafton Laboratories licence (a leaflet copy cites PL 12063/0068; the MHRA licence is PL 12063/0068-9, originally 'Paramed Nicotine Lozenges'). The Savers 2 mg page says it is no longer available online, but category pages still list it.
